Friends of Lackota Animal Sanctuary | Northern Colorado

Named after a rescued horse saved nearly 30 years ago, Friends of Lackota Animal Sanctuary was founded to give animals a second chance at life. The sanctuary began when a young boy refused to let Lackota go to slaughter—working hard to save him and, in the process, finding a lifelong purpose.

Located in Northern Colorado, we specialize in rescuing horses and donkeys from the slaughter pipeline, but no animal is turned away if we can provide proper care. Many arrive from kill pens or auctions, often neglected, afraid, and broken. Here, they receive love, rehabilitation, and safety—whether they find a forever home or remain at the sanctuary.

Our mission is simple: help animals beat the odds and live the life they deserve.
